entries.0b04671c7a9e7d80: Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥192,446 million for the Real Estate Business, which accounts for the bulk of the total, ¥11,465 million for the Energy Business, and ¥1,226 million for the Asset Management Business. entries.97d3456e7c226611: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥214,369 million, an increase of 9.1% from ¥196,523 million in the previous year. Real Estate Business accounted for most of it at ¥192,446 million, with the Energy Business at ¥11,465 million, the Other Business at ¥9,231 million and the Asset Management Business at ¥1,226 million.
entries.9e2ec7777a66ad08: It sets out its purpose as "to make the future of people and the Earth happy with the power to design a sustainable environment," and under its long-term vision "Be the treasure of the local community" aiming for the fiscal year ending March 2030, it aims to evolve into a "future environment design company." The medium-term management plan covering the fiscal year ending March 2028 (announced in May 2025 and updated in March 2026) positions the newly built detached house sales business and the renovation resale business as growth drivers of the Real Estate Business, and its policy is to actively invest in growth businesses while rebuilding the business portfolio, and to establish a medium- to long-term growth foundation.

entries.a0ab27ce44e6f0b4: A holding company whose core business is the development and sale of new condominiums for sale, and which also handles renewable energy power generation and the management of real estate and energy assets.
entries.b0ad685a000d831e: It consists of the Company, a holding company, 25 consolidated subsidiaries and eight equity-method affiliates. Consolidated subsidiaries include Takara Leben Co., Ltd. in the condominium business, MIRARTH Energy Solutions Co., Ltd. in the power generation business, and MIRARTH Asset Management Co., Ltd. in the asset management business. Consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 1,475.

entries.bd85a5820383613b: The group's core business. In addition to planning, developing and selling new-build condominiums under the “ＬＥＢＥＮ” and “ＮＥＢＥＬ” series nationwide, it carries out the full range of real estate business, including a securitization business that develops income-generating properties such as the “ＬＵＸＥＮＡ” series of residences and the “Ｌ．Ｂｉｚ” series of office buildings and sells them to the REIT market and others, new-build detached house sales, renovation resale business, real estate leasing and management business, and real estate brokerage business. Consolidated subsidiary Takara Leben Co., Ltd. is the core of the condominium business, Leben Community Co., Ltd. handles comprehensive management of condominiums, Leben Homebuild Co., Ltd. handles detached house sales, Takara Leben Real Net Co., Ltd. handles real estate distribution, Leben Zestock Co., Ltd. handles renovation resale, and Leben Trust Co., Ltd. handles rental management, each taking charge of its respective area. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥192,446 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue.
